about: packages/cdk5/src/props.json: the cdk5 story's part of the catalogue of 3D sets (props; docs/props.md, tools/packages/SPEC.md "Miniatures"): what the design room's card of each of its miniatures shows; code is authoritative

sets.shows: The human interactome's 16,376 proteins as glowing points flowing between the authors' six arrangements: the map of GO processes on a sphere (its knots of shared processes tagged), CDK5 with its activators, NTRK2 signalling, calpain, the Alzheimer's pathway, and the disease landscape the sphere opens into; each scene's links, CDK5's halo turning from green to red, its 205 partners' lines, its cousins, a pathway or a disease term lit, its 30 nearest in the landscape, and a veil that clears the view to the map's centre.
sets.frame: The map of processes a sphere of radius about 1 round the origin (proteins without a process on an outer shell at 1.2); each scene's centre proteins within 0.42 of the origin; the landscape's proteins with a disease round about (0, 0.16, 0.34), the rest on a sphere of radius 1.2 round them.

params.name: net_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: net_scene
params.meaning: 0..5: the authors' scene (0 map of processes, 1 activators, 2 NTRK2, 3 calpain, 4 Alzheimer's, 5 disease landscape); eased between integers

params.name: net_grow
params.meaning: the map grows from the centre (each protein by its radius and a seeded share), the links after (from 0.7); default 1

params.name: net_shell
params.meaning: the outer shell (proteins without a known process) on the sphere: 1 shown, 0 faint (18 %); default 1

params.name: net_links
params.meaning: the scene's links on or off; default 1

params.name: net_cdk5
params.meaning: CDK5 findable: its point in its state's colour, a halo (pulsing slowly), a ring facing the eye, its tag

params.name: net_hyper
params.meaning: CDK5's state colour: green CLOOK.C.cdk5 → red CLOOK.C.hyper (pulse faster); its tag gains "hyperactive" past 0.5

params.name: net_partners
params.meaning: lines shoot from CDK5 to its 205 partners (each at its own moment, pale green: C.partner mixed 45 % with CDK5's state colour), the partners brighten; tag "205 partners"

params.name: net_pick
params.meaning: step: -1, or a protein index: its ring (cyan), halo, tag "SYMBOL · n partners", its partners' lines in C.pick (alpha by degree) and the partners in C.partner; the rest steps back a little

params.name: net_family
params.meaning: the CDK family lights (pale lime halos); tags: "Its cousins · kinases of cell division" above the crowd within 5° of CDK5 and "CDK2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 · within 5° of it" below it, "CDK1 · 73° away", and the other cousins' names (minor, only while on the side facing the eye)

params.name: net_homes
params.meaning: p35 and p39 light where they are, with great-circle arcs from CDK5 drawn out over the sphere; tags "p35 · 99 degrees away", "p39 · 172 degrees away" (", round the back" and moved onto its arc when the protein is on the far side from the eye)

params.name: net_path
params.meaning: step: -1, 0 Signalling by NTRK2 (cyan), 1 the Alzheimer's pathway (orange): its members brighten wherever they are, with small halos

params.name: net_term
params.meaning: step: -1, or an index into CDATA.terms

params.name: net_termA
params.meaning: the term's proteins light magenta (C.term), the rest steps back to half; tag "name · n proteins" at its member nearest the middle

params.name: net_near
params.meaning: CDK5's 30 nearest in the landscape light (amber halos); tag "27 of its 30 nearest · share its brain-development terms" (nearTop[0].k) above them, and "YWHAE, ACTB, TUBA1A · among them" (the three best linked) below

params.name: net_veil
params.meaning: the points between the eye and the centre fade (above)

params.name: net_core
params.meaning: the current scene's centre proteins' own points and their links among each other fade (the core set draws them)

params.name: net_dim
params.meaning: everything not highlighted dims (to 12 %); links to 15 %

params.name: net_hub
params.meaning: APP lights; tag "APP · 2,123 partners"

params.name: net_shells
params.meaning: tags "13,003 with a known process" (inner shell) and "3,373 without" (outer shell)

params.name: net_landTags
params.meaning: tags "Proteins with a disease · 6,538" (the bulk's top) and "None known · pushed to the walls"

params.name: net_clouds
params.meaning: the map of processes' knots (CDATA.clouds, 14): each knot's proteins brighter and a little larger in the scene's own colours (no new hue), a soft glow at its centre in their mean colour, and a tag at its centre: a short name (a small map in the set for the long GO names, e.g. "Sugar import", "Glutamate synapses"; else the name, cut at 30 characters) and " · 7 of 15 here" (the GO name in explore, not on the tag: it ran off narrow screens). Only knots facing the eye are tagged, at most six, the most squarely facing first, none within 24° of one shown (tags run to the right). Scene 0 only: they fade as net_scene leaves 0 (gone by 0.35)

sets.notes: Every place, colour and link is the authors' (the CDK5_analytics VR project, through CDATA); the tags' numbers come from CDATA.

sets.shows: The close-up at the map's centre: each scene's centre proteins as lit balls with their names (CDK5 larger, green turning red), their links as glowing tubes, pulses running along NTRK2's and the Alzheimer's pathway's links, and the CDK5 - calpain link the authors drew flashing as p35 is cut.
sets.frame: In the net set's frame: the centre proteins within radius 0.42 of the origin.

params.name: core_a
params.meaning: the set's fade, 0 hidden to 1 shown (applied by the engine through setAlpha; a set never applies it itself)

params.name: core_scene
params.meaning: the scene; the engine keys it with net_scene. Between two scenes the balls move from one place to the next and a protein leaving or joining the centre fades with the move; scenes 0 and 5 have no centre

params.name: core_names
params.meaning: 1 every name, 0.5 the key ones only (BDNF, NTRK2, p35, p39, calpain, APP, LMNB1, FOXO3, GOLGA2, PRDX1, with short roles)

params.name: core_hyper
params.meaning: CDK5's ball green to red, its halo brighter and pulsing faster (two oscillators mixed, a function of t)

params.name: core_cut
params.meaning: the CDK5 - calpain link the authors drew comes in and flashes once (a function of the param alone); tags "p35 cut into p25 · CDK5 stays on" and "Drawn by the authors · calpain acts on p35" while the calpain scene shows

params.name: core_flow
params.meaning: pulses run along the pathway's links level by level (breadth-first): NTRK2's from BDNF and NTF4 in cyan (scene 2), the Alzheimer's from CDK5 in orange (scene 4); each protein brightens as the wave reaches it; a function of t
